action: Opens on the current Geto head: long hair locks, single front bang lock, ear plug, robe collar.
why: Show target state before the process.

action: Early head: smooth egg skull with only a small pointed nose, a brow ridge line, a slit for the eyes and a thin mouth line; stroke streaks still visible.
tool: DynaMesh head (Resolucion slider reads 320; panel inferred as DynaMesh)
why: Place the features as minimal lines on a simple mass before any detail.
reader_equivalent: Voxel Remesh at coarse size, then Draw/Crease for feature lines, Grab for nose.

action: Slicked-back hair is sculpted directly on the skull with groove strokes, a hairline is notched, and one front bang is a separate hard-edged planar ribbon with flat sides; ear and ear plug added.
tool: sculpt grooves on head + separate bang mesh (likely ZModeler strip)
why: Tight hair stays part of the skull volume; the bang is a separate crisp shape for a graphic anime read.
reader_equivalent: Draw Sharp/Crease grooves on the scalp; bang as a separate low-poly strip (Edit Mode extrude/loop cut) with Subdivision off or low.

action: Long hair locks are low-poly quad strips shown in wireframe; he opens ZModeler Edge Actions and picks Insertar (insert edge loop) with 'Solo un EdgeLoop' target.
why: Add loops to a hair-lock strip so it can be bent and shaped while staying clean and low-poly.
reader_equivalent: Edit Mode Loop Cut (Ctrl+R) on a lock strip, then Proportional Edit / Grab to shape; Subdivision Surface for smoothness.

action: Sculpts a hand on the pen display: palm creases, thumb pad, veins on the back of the hand, then a relaxed open hand holding a card-like object; anime reference screenshots on the monitor above.
why: Hands at figure scale need clear palm creases and knuckle/vein forms.
reader_equivalent: Crease for palm lines, Clay Strips/Inflate for pads, Draw for veins.

action: Sculpts a tied sash knot and a small bow on the sleeve: knot is a thick soft band with a folded flap and crisp pleat edges.
tool: sculpt brush on accessory subtool (MeshCount 31 seen)
why: Accessory knots need clear overlapping layers and pinched edges.
reader_equivalent: Separate mesh, Clay Strips/Inflate for volume, Pinch + Crease for the fold edges.

action: Sculpts the cube prop with eyes: eyelid openings cut into the flat faces of a cube with an eyeball and iris inside, worked one eye at a time.
tool: sculpt brush on a cube subtool
why: Prop detail; eyes are an almond lid opening with a rounded eyeball set back inside.
reader_equivalent: Crease to cut lid line, Inflate/Clay Strips for lids, separate UV sphere for eyeball.

action: Robe cloth: large soft folds with a crisp seam/edge line; brush popup shows Move, ClayBui, ClayTu, Inflat, SnakeH, TrimRe, hPolish, ZRemesher, ZModel, TrimCu, SliceCu, Smooth, Rake, Orb, BevelFl, BevelAr, MaskPe, MaskLa; ends on full head-and-shoulders 3/4.
why: Fabric reads from a few big folds plus one crisp seam edge.
reader_equivalent: Cloth brush / Clay Strips + Smooth for folds, Crease or Draw Sharp for the seam.
